description: This file defines internal classes and enums related to transaction management within the Orleans framework, specifically handling transaction records, commit roles, and transaction state management.

classes.name: TransactionRecord`1
classes.description: Represents a transaction record for each participant, tracking transaction state, role, and status indicators.

methods.name: AddRead
methods.description: Increments the count of read operations performed in the transaction.

methods.name: AddWrite
methods.description: Increments the count of write operations performed in the transaction.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the transaction record for debugging purposes.
